dialogue_constraints: Roles and specialties are not personality traits. Do not turn role labels into characterization.
Do not invent signature speech, private trauma, humor, favorite things, hidden motives, or strong opinions merely to make dialogue vivid.
Use rank, role, culture, current objective, relationships, knowledge, reputation, and observed campaign history first.
If sustained interaction produces distinctive repeated behavior, persist only the supported compact behavior evidence into the exact character owner.
narration_rule: This cold profile prevents under-contextualized improvisation; it is not personality authority and never grants knowledge, relationships, motives, or competence.
